verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents profiles as reusable, versioned configurations that can be saved, managed, and selected by ID. That gives agent setups a first-party form of versioning. Nothing in the evidence describes reviewing changes between profile versions or rolling back to a prior version, so only one thin element of the story is supported. Missing for 10: change review or diff between versions, documented rollback to earlier versions, any automation or workflow object beyond per-request agent profiles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
